meta.name: add-discord
meta.description: Add Discord bot channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 把 Discord 机器人频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为应用添加 Discord 机器人频道
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Discord bot channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect Discord bot channels to your application

howto.what: Claude 会从 channels 分支把 Discord 适配器复制进 src/channels/、追加一行注册导入并安装固定版本的适配器依赖,然后构建、跑注册测试,再引导你创建 Discord 机器人、粘贴 Bot Token、写入凭证并重启服务。
howto.when: 当你需要给 NanoClaw 接入 Discord 机器人频道时触发;它属于 /setup 流程的一环,也可在之后配合 /init-first-agent 或 /manage-channels 接线。

say.text: 帮我把 Discord 机器人频道接进来。
say.note: 会复制适配器、追加注册导入并安装依赖。

say.text: 这是我的 Bot Token,继续配置 Discord。
say.note: 会校验 token 并推导应用凭证。

say.text: Discord 机器人上线了但收不到我的消息。

howto.what_en: Claude copies the Discord adapter from the channels branch, registers it, installs the pinned adapter package, builds and runs the registration test, then guides you to create the bot, paste its token, store credentials and restart.
howto.when_en: When you need to add a Discord bot channel to NanoClaw; it is part of the /setup flow and can also be wired later with /init-first-agent or /manage-channels.

say_en.text: Add the Discord bot channel for me.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it, installs the package.

say_en.text: Here is my Bot Token — continue the Discord setup.
say_en.note: Validates the token and derives the app credentials.

say_en.text: The Discord bot is online but never sees my messages.
say_en.note: Checks Message Content Intent and shared servers.
